result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would ensure universal access to quality education—especially in critical thinking, empathy, and problem-solving—from an early age and throughout life.

Why? Because education isn’t just about facts or job skills; it’s the foundation for informed choices, compassionate societies, and sustainable innovation. When people understand how to evaluate information, consider diverse perspectives, and collaborate across differences, many other problems—like inequality, misinformation, and conflict—become more solvable.

In short: empower minds, and you empower humanity to heal and build itself.
